Specifically observe whether26choices and the narrow one-column grid permit comfortable finding of larger answers. If this is burdensome, commission a bounded response-control revision and repeat affected keyboard/reflow/truth checks.

Inspect the compact invitation, explicit guided-practice choice, related discoveries and both workshops. Move/change units, undo/reset, reveal symbols and start separate practice; confirm exploration is understood as unassessed and reversible.

For actual accessibility evidence repeat changed views using native browser200%zoom and target screen reader; report delivered prompt, unit/side meaning, focus and one useful outcome. Browser names/roles do not substitute for this.

For changed-surface physical offline evidence repeat the prepared disconnected-device restart/reopen protocol with synthetic badges/preferences and new chapter task; distinguish cached gameplay from speech availability.
